name: workflow_todo
description: Get the list of pending workflow tasks assigned to a user. Use this when the CEO agent needs to show the human 'what needs your decision right now' or when an agent needs to find a task to act on. Each task has: id, name, processInstanceId, createTime, dueDate (optional), and the current process variables. Tasks come from z-camuda's Camunda engine. By default returns tasks in 'todo' state (not yet started).

userId.description: z-ctc username to filter tasks. e.g. 'admin', 'ceo', 'dev-lead'.

processCode.description: Optional: filter by process definition key. e.g. '5-look-evaluation' to only show evaluation tasks.

limit.description: Max number of tasks to return. Default 20.
